subject: gk
question: The Tumakuru mining belt is located in which state?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Tumakuru mining belt** is located in the state of **Karnataka**.
 
• Karnataka is rich in **mineral resources** and has a significant **mining industry**.
 
• The state is known for its **iron ore, manganese, and gold deposits**.
 
• **Tumakuru** district is one of the prominent mining areas in Karnataka.
 
• The mining activities in Tumakuru contribute to the **economic development** of the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Odisha**__

 __
 
• **Odisha** is well-known for its rich mineral resources, particularly **bauxite, iron ore, and coal**.
 
• It is one of the leading states in **mineral production** in India.
 
 
 
• **Jharkhand**__
 __
 
• **Jharkhand** is another state rich in minerals, especially **coal, iron ore, copper, and mica**.
 
• The state has several large-scale mining operations and is a major contributor to India's **mining industry**.
 
 
 
• **Rajasthan**__
 
 
• **Rajasthan** is renowned for its **marble, granite, and other stone mining**.
 
• The state is also known for **zinc and lead** mining.
